item.blurb: Voyage Labs Raises $12M Seed. Voyage Labs raises $12 million in a seed round led by Kleiner Perkins to scale its AI-powered travel planning platform Atlas.
Valkryn Raises $15M Seed. Valkryn raises $15M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz to scale its autonomous warfare testing and evaluation software infrastructure.
Mulga Raises $1.77M Pre-seed. Mulga raises $1.77 million in pre-seed funding to expand its open-source Spinifex platform, helping enterprises run AWS workloads on any compute infrastructure.
Iconic Raises $10M Seed. Iconic raises $10M in seed funding led by Peak Capital to expand its AI platform for managing and reviewing large capital project documentation.
Remanence Raises $30M Seed. Remanence raises $30 million in a seed round led by EQT Ventures and FirstMark to help companies train and own their proprietary AI models.
Nvidia-backed Genesis AI raises $500M Series A at $3.5B valuation to build general-purpose robots. What if robots could do more than repeat a single programmed task? Imagine a machine that can pack…
Model ML Raises $250M Series B. Model ML raises $250M Series B at a $1.5B valuation led by General Atlantic and QED Investors to automate financial modeling and analysis.
Sensei Labs Raises Series B. Sensei Labs raises a Series B round led by Straylight Capital to scale its AI-native strategy execution platform and accelerate market expansion.
Compute Desk Raises $45M in Funding. Compute Desk raises $45M in a funding round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners to scale its compute-focused financial clearing and trading platform.
Payhawk Raises $280M Series C. Payhawk raises $280M in a Series C round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives at a $2B valuation to scale its AI-native finance operating system.
Akua Secures Investment. Akua receives an investment from Itaú Ventures to implement its artificial intelligence payment acquiring technology for Itaú in Uruguay.
